descriptions.fullDescription:
Uptime Kuma is an open-source uptime monitoring application allowing users to set up alerts for their infrastructure.

It support multiple monitor types, including: HTTP/HTTPs, TCP Port, Ping, DNS, certificate expiry...

Users can set granular alerts using one of the many supported social services.

Public status pages are also supported, with the option of communicating maintenance windows and incidents.

Version Information

Since version 2.x Uptime Kuma supports MariaDB as the datastore instead of SQLite. This allows Uptime Kuma to be much more responsive, especially when many monitors are defined. Unfortunately no direct migration path is available between 1.x and 2.x and users are encouraged to manually transfer their list of monitors. To use MariaDB with Uptime Kuma 2.x, users can choose the embedded MariaDB option presented to them during the initial start after deployment.
